1.primary: Geometric mean of pruned latency relative to full-byte, equally weighted over500queries and3processes.
limitations: Separate processes/treatment with balanced fixed orders, not a within-process three-way randomization.
SharedGPU, uncontrolledclocks/cache; only3processes, repeated calibration; no held-out/service-tail or causal cross-host conclusion.
